d: Mallikarjun Kharge On Modi: At an event in Patna, Congress MP Mallikarjun Kharge's remarks sparked a controversy. In the video that is going viral, an unidentified person can be heard saying that PM Modi cannot be removed, retorting to that, Mallikarjun Kharge said that not just Modi but his father will be removed as well. Responding to the remarks, the BJP has called for a nationwide protest against Kharge. The NDA leaders have been critical of the statement, however the opposition questions the selective outrage.
